message:
1 templates carry a node kind this walk does not know:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html: ContentBlock
description: A `@content` block, a foreign component's slot: the parser makes it with no error and no flag, and `ngc` refuses it outside a foreign component (`NG8026`), of which the library has none. What a foreign component draws of the block is its render function's, which no reading of this gate follows, so the kind is left out of `KNOWN_NODES`, and the day the library takes one the gate says so. The marker draws a template of its own beside the widget's, so that the refusal counts and names the one template of two.
